## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` pass
- [ ] Tested only against a throwaway Claude config folder, never the real login
- [ ] UI changes were looked at (demo page or the running app); screenshots attached
- [ ] `docs/spec.md` / `docs/implementation.md` and README updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under *Unreleased*
